## Description and Rationale

The three of us are a group of 4th year students completing our Bachelors this year in Data Science and Computer Science in India. We decided to register for this challenge because it's a good opportunity to test our skills and compete with talent around the globe. The prospect of working on aviation data and paving ways to solve a bottleneck is exciting and a great learning opportunity for us.
